    Minimum and maximum of each covariate, for rescaling

    deriveCovMinMax.Rd

    Fuel biomass columns all get fireSenseUtils::fuelLinearRange, c(0, 1e4): a fixed range, not the data's, so that rescaling is biomass / 1e4 in every polygon and in every predicted year.

    deriveCovMinMax(
  annualList,
  nonAnnualList,
  fuelCols,
  fixedRange = fireSenseUtils::climateCovRanges
)

    Arguments

    annualList

    list of data.tables of annual covariates, one per year.

    nonAnnualList

    list of data.tables of non-annual covariates, fuel biomass on the LINEAR scale.

    fuelCols

    names of the fuel biomass columns, from fuelColumns().

    fixedRange

    named list of c(min, max) that replace the data's range for those covariates; default fireSenseUtils::climateCovRanges. Every annual covariate that is not a 0/1 indicator is climate and must be in it, or this stops. Indicators are always c(0, 1).

    Value

    data.table with 2 rows (min, max) and one column per covariate. Stops if a covariate that is not given a fixed range has max <= min.
